verdict: Nvidia's revenue jumped 85% to a record $81.6B as the Blackwell ramp drove Data Center sales up 92% — and a $15.9B paper gain on its investment portfolio lifted net income to $58.3B, well beyond what the chip business alone earned.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: AI data-center platforms (the Blackwell 300 ramp); up 92% YoY and 92% of total revenue. Within it, Hyperscale was $37,869M (+115% YoY) and AI Clouds, Industrial & Enterprise was $37,377M (+74% YoY).

segments.name: Edge Computing
segments.note: PC, workstation, robotics and automotive platforms; up 29% YoY on strong Blackwell workstation demand, partly offset by slower consumer PC sales.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: R&D spending on new chips and platforms like Vera Rubin; up 58% YoY as Nvidia hires and builds faster.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Sales and admin costs; up 25% YoY, growing far slower than revenue.

otherDetail: Other income of $16,367M: net gains on equity securities of about $15.9B (mostly unrealized gains on stocks Nvidia owns), plus $540M of interest income, less $102M of interest expense.
follow100Note: Data Center takes $92.20 of every $100 — and $20.05 more comes in from gains on Nvidia's stock portfolio and interest. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Data Center is nearly the whole company
takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit a record $75.2B, up 92% — 92% of all revenue. Hyperscalers bought $37.9B of AI platforms, and AI clouds, industrial and enterprise customers another $37.4B. No Hopper products were shipped to China in the quarter.

takeaways.title: A big slice of profit is paper gains
takeaways.text: Net gains on equity securities added about $15.9B to other income. That is why GAAP net income of $58.3B sits far above non-GAAP's $45.5B — the gap is investment gains, not chip sales.

takeaways.title: Cash generation is enormous
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $50.3B and free cash flow $48.6B in a single quarter. Nvidia returned about $20.0B to shareholders and added an $80B buyback authorization.

oneTimers: Net gains from equity securities of about $15.9B lifted GAAP other income (excluded from non-GAAP results) — the main reason GAAP net income of $58,321M exceeds non-GAAP net income of $45,548M.

The year-ago quarter carried $4.5B of H20 charges (export restrictions on China-bound chips), which is why gross margin jumped from 60.5% to 74.9% year over year — the comparison flatters this quarter.
